checks: Printed p.=PDF−11 on numbered pages. PDF42–43 gives 40°/140° versus 90° angles and distinct empirical standards for the Ag and Zr experiments.
PDF47 Table 5-1, 346.3-keV intensity and RADO reproduce the journal Table I; the publications list on PDF88 confirms the relationship.
PDF67–68: the 1544.2-keV 91Zr and 1006.5-keV 92Zr lines illustrate high angular ratios with conditional l-forbidden M1 assignments. Main Ag and Zr tables do not report P.
works.gap: Fits depend on coincidence placement and regional model assignments. Prior isomer timing is external; absolute strengths for the candidate partner sequence were not measured here.
works.lineage: The Ag experiment is shared with Wang et al. 2013 PRC 88 024306. The Zr reaction has a different acquisition and its own related papers.
